Definition: to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to prophesy; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to prophesy; 1a1a) under influence of divine spirit; 1a1b) of false prophets; 1b)(Hithpael); 1b1) to prophesy; 1b1a) under influence of divine spirit; 1b1b) of false prophets
